summary: The rules file is empty (a single byte) and the claims file lists zero claims, so there is nothing to test from rules back to the page. The page has no triage, danger-sign or 'likely/consider' diagnostic logic, only management steps (advice, treatment, review schedule, and the red box 'Treat the HIV positive patient in labour': continue ART if on ART, otherwise NVP 200mg plus TLD, start ART next day, infant prophylaxis). An empty rule set is defensible if management-only pages are meant to produce no rules, but if the red box is expected to be encoded (e.g. as a check task or priority evaluation on HIV-positive in labour), it is wholly missing; that is for the forward checkers and reconciler to judge.
